layout_is_enabled.light_note: Real port bug (state application). In the 'All children are enabled' section both buttons are created {true,true} (set_is_enabled(true)), and the IsEnabled coercion is correct (explicit-true + enabled parent → is_enabled()==true), yet iOS renders the SECOND button's title gray (disabled appearance) while the first is blue (enabled); MAUI renders BOTH blue. So a default-enabled button's native enabled state isn't applied for the 2nd+ child (map_is_enabled is a no-op when value==default, so the native UIButton keeps a stale/disabled appearance for siblings). Other sections that SHOULD be disabled look right by coincidence. Needs runtime (lldb) confirmation of button[1].is_enabled() + when map_is_enabled runs at host time.

tabbed_flyout.dark_note: ROOT CAUSE (diagnosed, effort-L fix): renders fully blank because the iOS gallery window-host (ios_gallery.mm ~line 99) treats page() as an i_view and grafts its native .view into rootViewController.view. But this page's root is a flyout_page (detail = a tabbed_page) — on iOS those are VIEW CONTROLLERS (UISplitViewController/UITabBarController), not plain views. Grafting their .view without installing the page's view-CONTROLLER as the window rootViewController (or proper child-VC containment) means UISplitVC/UITabBarVC child-VC lifecycle (viewDidLoad / child presentation) never fires, so nothing populates. Handlers ARE registered in both lists (not a registration miss). FIX: window host must detect a VC-backed root page (flyout/tabbed/navigation) and set it as the window rootViewController instead of grafting its view. Affects any VC-backed page used as a window root.
